description: This file implements a parallel processing pipeline class for a multimedia framework, enabling concurrent frame processing across multiple sub-pipelines with lifecycle management and synchronization.

classes.name: ParallelPipeline
classes.description: A class providing a concurrent frame processing pipeline that manages multiple sub-pipelines, handling synchronization of specific system frames and their lifecycle, with setup and cleanup capabilities.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args)
methods.description: Initializes the ParallelPipeline with multiple processor lists, creating individual sub-pipelines for concurrent processing.

methods.name: processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-pipelines contained within this parallel pipeline.

methods.name: List["FrameProcessor"] entry_processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of entry point processors, which are the sub-pipelines for this parallel pipeline.

methods.name: List[FrameProcessor] processors_with_metrics(self)
methods.description: Collects and returns all processors within sub-pipelines that support metrics collection.

methods.name: setup(self, setup: FrameProcessorSetup)
methods.description: Sets up the parallel pipeline and all its sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources for the parallel pipeline and all sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes a frame through all sub-pipelines in parallel, with synchronization for system frames like StartFrame, EndFrame, and CancelFrame.

methods.name: _parallel_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Pushes a frame to the output only if it has not been seen before, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _pipeline_sink_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles completion of processing for system frames and triggers the transfer of frames once all sub-pipelines have processed a particular frame.
